references.text: Describes Mount Sinai enveloped in smoke because the Lord descended upon it in fire, paralleling God's speech from the fire, cloud, and darkness.
The introduction to the Ten Commandments which God spoke, the same event described in Deuteronomy 5:22.
God gives Moses the stone tablets with the law and commandments that He has written, paralleling how God wrote the words on two stone tablets.
God gave Moses the two tablets of the testimony, stone tablets written by the finger of God.
Describes the two tablets of the testimony which were written on both sides, the work of God and the writing of God.
The Ten Commandments were written on the tablets, paralleling the description that God wrote the commandments on the stone tablets.
A parallel description of the event at Horeb with fire, cloud, and darkness, and the Ten Commandments written on stone tablets.
The Lord gave Moses two stone tablets written by the finger of God, containing all the words the Lord spoke from the fire on the mountain.
God wrote on the tablets the Ten Commandments that He had spoken to the people from the fire on the mountain.
Refers to the Sinai event with fire, darkness, storm, and trumpet sound, and a voice that spoke.
